pairs.question: Quid est homini inimicissimum?
pairs.derivation: Single-line author self-Q&A. Question is the interrogative clause up to the '?'; answer is the contiguous reply 'alter homo' (capitalized as first word, period added). Nothing cut between.

pairs.question: Quae sunt maximae divitiae?
pairs.derivation: Single-line author self-Q&A. Answer is the full contiguous reply after '?', capitalized and given a period. Nothing omitted.

pairs.question: Quis plurimum habet?
pairs.derivation: Single-line author self-Q&A. Reply 'is qui minimum cupit' answers the question directly; capitalized first word, period added.

pairs.question: Quid est dare beneficium?
pairs.derivation: Single-line author self-Q&A. Answer is the contiguous reply after '?', capitalized with period. Nothing cut.

pairs.question: Quis est pauper?
pairs.derivation: Single-line author self-Q&A. Reply answers directly; capitalized first word, period added. Nothing omitted.

pairs.question: Vis omnibus esse notus?
pairs.derivation: Single-line author self-Q&A (rhetorical question 'vis...?' answered by an imperative). Answer is the full contiguous reply after '?', capitalized with period. Nothing cut.

pairs.question: Vis habere honorem?
pairs.answer: Dabo tibi magnum imperium: impera tibi.
pairs.derivation: Single-line author self-Q&A. Answer kept whole because the colon joins 'dabo tibi magnum imperium' with its explanatory 'impera tibi' as one answering sentence (no full stop intervenes); capitalized first word, period added.

pairs.locus: Publilius Syrus, Sententiae Falso Receptae (S, scis quid est invidia)
pairs.question: Quid est invidia?
pairs.answer: Dolor animi est ex alienis commodis.
pairs.derivation: Source line is 'Scis, quid est invidia? dolor animi est ex alienis commodis.' The framing 'Scis,' is dropped as a meta-narration of the asking, leaving the genuine interrogative as question; answer is the contiguous reply after '?', capitalized with period.

pairs.locus: Publilius Syrus, Sententiae Falso Receptae (I, imperium habere)
pairs.question: Imperium habere vis magnum?
pairs.derivation: Single-line author self-Q&A. Question is the interrogative clause; answer is the contiguous imperative reply, capitalized with period.

pairs.derivation: Single-line author self-Q&A. Answer is the full conditional reply after '?' (already capitalized in source), period retained. Nothing cut.

pairs.answer: Multo illud plus est, quod non habes.
pairs.derivation: Single-line author self-Q&A. Answer is the full contiguous reply after '?', capitalized first word, period retained. Nothing cut.
